'''Kentara''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who became a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==Biography==
Kentara was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Kentara disappeared. No one was sure of his whereabouts, but rumors circulated that Kentara was on a secret mission for [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]].<ref name="Enslaved" /> Kentara was on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bundim]] in the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]] during an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] assault on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], and was [[Prison/Legends|captured]] at the [[Battle of Heg]]. The Imperials did not know of Kentara's importance to the Alliance,<ref name="Return">{{WEGCite|story=Return to Bundim|book=Star Wars Gamemaster Kit}}</ref> and he ended up in the possession of [[Harthusa]], a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] based on [[Deysum III]]. During an auction, Kentara was sold to [[Quintarus Returyl]], a representative of the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice Mines of Kessel]]. However,
an Alliance team witnessed the auction and recognized Kentara; they were on Deysum III investigating the construction of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] resupply depot in the [[Bissillirus system/Legends|Bissillirus system]]. The same night, the Alliance agents rescued Kentara and the other [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] being held in the [[slave camp]] outside the [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="Enslaved" /> Following his rescue, Kentara insisted on returning to Bundim to aid the continuing fight against the Empire. Providing his rescuers with all the knowledge he had regarding the occupation forces on the planet, the Alliance team braved the Imperial blockade of the planet and returned Kentara to the remains of the Alliance forces on the planet, under the command of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Kray'geen T'ihar]].<ref name="Return" />
